visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with an eye-level static shot of a 7-Eleven storefront on a bright, sunny day. The clear blue sky reflects off the store's glass windows. The iconic red, green, and orange logo is centered on the light-colored modern building. On-screen text in Traditional Chinese asks if this is an American 7-Eleven. (2) The camera pans downward to show a black car door swinging open in a concrete parking lot. A person wearing gray jogger-style pants and dark shoes steps out onto the pavement. The lighting is harsh natural daylight, creating strong shadows. The person's upper body is mostly obscured as they exit the vehicle. (3) A young boy with short black hair, wearing a light gray short-sleeved t-shirt and dark trousers, walks toward the store's entrance. A man in a plain white t-shirt and dark shorts walks ahead of him. The setting is a clean, modern shopping plaza with parked cars and green bushes visible. (4) Inside the store, the camera captures a close-up of a heated glass display unit. Multiple shelves hold golden-brown fried chicken wings, breast pieces, and slices of pepperoni pizza on paper plates. Red price tags and marketing slogans like "$5 BIG SLICE" are visible under bright fluorescent indoor lighting. (5) The focus shifts to a tiered display rack filled with large, American-style cookies and baked goods. Each item is individually wrapped or placed on a tray. The background shows other store aisles with various packaged snacks, maintaining a clean and well-organized retail environment. (6) The shot moves to a hot dog roller grill where several sausages and cylindrical Mexican-style wraps are rotating slowly. The metal surface of the grill glints under the lights. Small tongs for customers to use are placed neatly to the side of the display. (7) A wide panning shot shows the beverage station, featuring a long row of sleek, black automated coffee and cappuccino machines. Numerous colorful dispensers for creamers and syrups are organized alongside stacks of paper cups. The floor is a polished dark gray tile. (8) Three large Slurpee machines are shown side-by-side, each featuring multiple dispensing handles and brightly colored flavor labels. The internal tanks are filled with swirling semi-frozen liquids in vibrant shades of green, red, blue, and yellow, creating a colorful and high-arousal visual focus. (9) A tighter close-up of the Slurpee dispensers reveals specific brand logos like Coca-Cola and Mountain Dew on the flavor buttons. The machines appear clean and well-maintained. The narrator uses text to point out that there are eleven different flavors available for customers to choose from. (10) The boy's hands are shown operating one of the Slurpee levers. He carefully fills a clear plastic cup, first with a bright blue flavor and then layering a yellow-green flavor on top. The slushy texture of the drink is clearly visible as it mounds up inside the cup. (11) Transitioning back to the car interior, a hand holds a completed multi-colored Slurpee in a "BIG GULP" branded plastic cup with a dome lid and a lime-green straw. Sunlight streams through the car window, illuminating the vibrant blue and green layers of the frozen beverage. (12) In the back seat of the car, the young boy sits buckled into his seatbelt. He holds the Slurpee in one hand and uses the other to open a white triangular cardboard pizza box with the 7-Eleven logo. He looks down at the pepperoni pizza slice with anticipation. (13) The boy picks up the pizza slice and takes a large, satisfying bite. He chews with a neutral to happy expression while looking toward the camera. The car interior is beige and modern, providing a soft-lit background for this final lifestyle and food consumption scene.
